title: Specificity stress tests for low-prevalence screening
description: Curated excerpts support evaluating screening models by specificity and false-positive burden under low-prevalence and subgroup settings.
why_existing_work_does_not_solve_it: The synthetic prior work emphasizes sensitivity, AUROC, and calibration but not low-prevalence specificity stress tests.
why_it_matters: False positives can dominate real screening workloads in rare-condition settings.
possible_research_questions: Which calibration protocols reduce subgroup false-positive burden at fixed sensitivity?
minimum_experiment_needed: Evaluate sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV, and subgroup false-positive rates under simulated low-prevalence deployment.
risk_that_gap_is_fake: A real medical search may find domain-specific screening protocols with these metrics.
